g.text: Low-voltage controller only. No mains on this PCB.

g.desc: Low-voltage controller only. No mains on this PCB.

g.text: ULN2003A/G6K pickup margin requires bench validation.

g.desc: ULN2003A/G6K pickup margin requires bench validation.

g.text: 30R preload: ~167mA / 0.83W at 5V. Use 3W flameproof; keep clear of capacitors.

g.desc: 30R preload: ~167mA / 0.83W at 5V. Use 3W flameproof; keep clear of capacitors.

g.text: 100R + 47u filters switching ripple. Bias ~1.1V; LM358 retained.

g.desc: 100R + 47u filters switching ripple. Bias ~1.1V; LM358 retained.

g.text: SPU03 INPUT IS 5V ONLY. Check isolated raw rails 4-6V and quiet rails >=3.6V.

g.desc: SPU03 INPUT IS 5V ONLY. Check isolated raw rails 4-6V and quiet rails >=3.6V.

g.text: never in the main audio path.

g.desc: never in the main audio path.

g.text: Nominal midband input impedance ~570k. AC gain ~101 x 100/570 = 17.7.

g.desc: Nominal midband input impedance ~570k. AC gain ~101 x 100/570 = 17.7.

g.text: Nominal trigger ~4mVrms at 1kHz; tuning/bench value, not a guaranteed noise threshold.

g.desc: Nominal trigger ~4mVrms at 1kHz; tuning/bench value, not a guaranteed noise threshold.

g.text: At 2Vrms the detector saturates intentionally; it is outside the through audio path.

g.desc: At 2Vrms the detector saturates intentionally; it is outside the through audio path.

g.text: 470k limits loading when unpowered. Design input: up to 2Vrms sine (2.83V peak).

g.desc: 470k limits loading when unpowered. Design input: up to 2Vrms sine (2.83V peak).

g.text: Isolated return is tied ONLY to SEL_L_RETURN, after its source-selection relay.

g.desc: Isolated return is tied ONLY to SEL_L_RETURN, after its source-selection relay.

g.text: No detector wire, resistor, capacitor or shield connects this return to control GND or the other channel.

g.desc: No detector wire, resistor, capacitor or shield connects this return to control GND or the other channel.
